summary: Teaches how to set up Grafana Database Observability for PostgreSQL by preparing the DB, configuring Alloy via the wizard, and verifying telemetry.

needs.description: PostgreSQL 14+ with pg_stat_statements, compute_query_id=on, track_activity_query_size=4096, and a monitoring user with pg_monitor/pg_read_all_stats; reachable directly (no pooler).
needs.evidence: Before you begin: "A running PostgreSQL 14.0 or later instance"

needs.description: Host running Grafana Alloy 1.17.0+ with network access to the PostgreSQL instance and Grafana Cloud, using the config copied from the wizard (database name postgres_primary).
needs.evidence: Before you begin: "A machine where you can install Grafana Alloy 1.17.0 or later"; configure-alloy fills "postgres_primary"

needs.description: Database Observability app (grafana-dbo11y-app) activated in the stack so /a/grafana-dbo11y-app/configuration works.
needs.evidence: Before you begin: "Database Observability activated in your Grafana Cloud stack"

needs.description: Telemetry from a monitored PostgreSQL instance so Telemetry status tab and Overview page show data.
User with Editor or Admin role

reviewNotes: Wizard steps (Add a database, Telemetry status) may pass UI-only without real data; data-dependent steps need a live Alloy+Postgres.
